t: The $(item)Advanced Liquid Compressor/$ is the $(l:base_concepts/pressure_tiers)tier 2/$ version of the $(l:compressors/liquid_compressor)Liquid Compressor/$, with a maximum safe pressure of 20 bar. It generates a base 50mL air/tick, and can be upgraded with $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)Speed Upgrades/$.$(p)However, this generator must be $(l:base_concepts/heat)cooled/$, as its efficiency will drop as the temperature rises, up to the point where no air is generated at all.

$(item)高级液体压缩机/$是$(l:compressors/liquid_compressor)液体压缩机/$的$(l:base_concepts/pressure_tiers)阶段2/$版本，最大安全压力为 20 bar。它的基础产气速度为 50mL/tick，并且可以安装$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)速度升级/$。$(p)不过，这台机器必须$(l:base_concepts/heat)冷却/$，因为随着温度升高，它的效率会下降，严重时甚至会完全无法产生空气。
合成一个$(item)高级液体压缩机/$
